Was the Claude Code hack really about Claude, or did it expose a much bigger problem with AI security? This week on Hack5's ThreatWire, Ali breaks down how the Cursor marketplace attack reached Anthropic's Claude Code extension through a third-party compromise, plus how prompt injection and security weaknesses put OpenAI Codex's GitHub Actions and npm publishing at risk. From AI supply chain attacks to credential theft and LLMjacking, discover why even trusted AI coding tools can become attack vectors.
